verses.text_en: Now when Darius reigned, he made a great feast unto all his subjects, and unto all his household, and unto all the princes of Media and Persia,
verses.text_hr: Kad je Darije postao kraljem, priredio je veliku gozbu svim svojim podanicima, svemu svojem dvoru i svim knezovima Medije i Perzije,

verses.text_en: And to all the governors and captains and lieutenants that were under him, from India unto Ethiopia, of an hundred twenty and seven provinces.
verses.text_hr: svim namjesnicima, zapovjednicima i upraviteljima pod svojom vlašću, od Indije do Etiopije, u sto dvadeset i sedam pokrajina.

verses.text_en: And when they had eaten and drunken, and being satisfied were gone home, then Darius the king went into his bedchamber, and slept, and soon after awaked.
verses.text_hr: Kad su se najeli i napili te siti otišli kućama, kralj Darije povukao se u svoju spavaonicu, zaspao, a nedugo zatim probudio.

verses.text_en: Then three young men, that were of the guard that kept the king’s body, spake one to another;
verses.text_hr: Tada su tri mladića iz straže koja je čuvala kraljevo tijelo rekla jedan drugomu:

verses.text_en: Let every one of us speak a sentence: he that shall overcome, and whose sentence shall seem wiser than the others, unto him shall the king Darius give great gifts, and great things in token of victory:
verses.text_hr: „Neka svaki od nas izrekne jednu tvrdnju. Onomu koji pobijedi i čija se tvrdnja pokaže mudrijom od ostalih kralj Darije dat će velike darove i znamenite nagrade pobjede:

verses.text_en: As, to be clothed in purple, to drink in gold, and to sleep upon gold, and a chariot with bridles of gold, and an headtire of fine linen, and a chain about his neck:
verses.text_hr: odjenut će ga u grimiz, dat će mu da pije iz zlata i spava na zlatu, dat će mu kola sa zlatnim uzdama, povez od finoga lana i lanac oko vrata.

verses.text_en: And he shall sit next to Darius because of his wisdom, and shall be called Darius his cousin.
verses.text_hr: Zbog svoje mudrosti sjedit će do Darija i zvat će ga Darijevim rođakom.“

verses.text_en: And then every one wrote his sentence, sealed it, and laid it under king Darius his pillow;
verses.text_hr: Potom je svaki napisao svoju tvrdnju, zapečatio je i položio pod uzglavlje kralja Darija.

verses.text_en: And said that, when the king is risen, some will give him the writings; and of whose side the king and the three princes of Persia shall judge that his sentence is the wisest, to him shall the victory be given, as was appointed.
verses.text_hr: Rekli su: „Kad kralj ustane, netko će mu predati zapise. Onomu za čiju tvrdnju kralj i trojica perzijskih knezova presude da je najmudrija pripast će pobjeda, kako je određeno.“

verses.text_en: The first wrote, Wine is the strongest.
verses.text_hr: Prvi je napisao: „Vino je najjače.“

verses.text_en: The second wrote, The king is strongest.
verses.text_hr: Drugi je napisao: „Kralj je najjači.“

verses.text_en: The third wrote, Women are strongest: but above all things Truth beareth away the victory.
verses.text_hr: Treći je napisao: „Žene su najjače, ali iznad svega Istina odnosi pobjedu.“

verses.text_en: Now when the king was risen up, they took their writings, and delivered them unto him, and so he read them:
verses.text_hr: Kad je kralj ustao, uzeli su svoje zapise i predali mu ih da ih pročita.

verses.text_en: And sending forth he called all the princes of Persia and Media, and the governors, and the captains, and the lieutenants, and the chief officers;
verses.text_hr: On je poslao glasnike i sazvao sve knezove Perzije i Medije, namjesnike, zapovjednike, upravitelje i najviše službenike.

verses.text_en: And sat him down in the royal seat of judgment; and the writings were read before them.
verses.text_hr: Sjeo je na kraljevsko sudačko prijestolje, a zapisi su pročitani pred njima.

verses.text_en: And he said, Call the young men, and they shall declare their own sentences. So they were called, and came in.
verses.text_hr: Tada reče: „Pozovite mladiće da sami obrazlože svoje tvrdnje.“ Pozvali su ih i oni su ušli.

verses.text_en: And he said unto them, Declare unto us your mind concerning the writings. Then began the first, who had spoken of the strength of wine;
verses.text_hr: Kralj im reče: „Izložite nam svoju misao o onome što ste napisali.“ Tada je počeo prvi, onaj koji je govorio o snazi vina.

verses.text_en: And he said thus, O ye men, how exceeding strong is wine! it causeth all men to err that drink it:
verses.text_hr: Rekao je: „Ljudi, kako je samo silno vino! Ono zavodi svakoga tko ga pije.

verses.text_en: It maketh the mind of the king and of the fatherless child to be all one; of the bondman and of the freeman, of the poor man and of the rich:
verses.text_hr: Um kralja izjednačuje s umom siročeta, roba sa slobodnjakom, siromaha s bogatašem.

verses.text_en: It turneth also every thought into jollity and mirth, so that a man remembereth neither sorrow nor debt:
verses.text_hr: Svaku misao okreće prema veselju i radosti, tako da se čovjek ne sjeća ni žalosti ni duga.

verses.text_en: And it maketh every heart rich, so that a man remembereth neither king nor governor; and it maketh to speak all things by talents:
verses.text_hr: Svako srce čini bogatim, pa se čovjek ne sjeća ni kralja ni namjesnika; navodi ga da o svemu govori bez mjere.

verses.text_en: And when they are in their cups, they forget their love both to friends and brethren, and a little after draw out swords:
verses.text_hr: Kad se opiju, ljudi zaborave svoju ljubav prema prijateljima i braći te ubrzo potežu mačeve.

verses.text_en: But when they are from the wine, they remember not what they have done.
verses.text_hr: Ali kad se otrijezne od vina, ne sjećaju se što su učinili.

verses.text_en: O ye men, is not wine the strongest, that enforceth to do thus? And when he had so spoken, he held his peace.
verses.text_hr: Ljudi, nije li vino najjače kad čovjeka prisiljava na takva djela?“ Kad je to rekao, zašutio je.
